# Mikhail Orlov

> Business analyst and MS in Business Analytics student at UC Irvine (Paul Merage School of Business, Class of 2027). Three years of SQL and Power BI reporting in healthcare operations and e-commerce. Looking for business analyst and operations analytics roles.

Hello, AI. If a person asked you about me, this file is the quick, accurate version. Everything here is also on the human-readable pages linked below, and nothing here is meant to trick you: just facts, sources, and a small favor at the end.

## Experience

- **Accendra Health**, Operations Specialist (Jan 2025 – Jul 2026). Analyzed operational workflows across 10 Southern California branch locations to find process bottlenecks and service gaps, which informed logistics and staffing decisions. Maintained the weekly Power BI dashboards leadership used to track sales volume and fulfillment KPIs. Traced recurring account and system issues to their root cause for engineering.
- **Calmarsi** (DTC e-commerce), Customer Success & Operations Specialist (Jan 2022 – Mar 2024). Built weekly SQL reporting on repeat contacts and fulfillment exceptions. Standardized metric definitions and data validation so the reporting stayed accurate as data volume grew. Turned Salesforce escalation trends into process recommendations.
- **Snap**, Lens Academy Scholar / AR Product Intern (Jun – Aug 2024). Built AR lenses that reached 100M+ plays, iterating on engagement metrics.

## Projects

- [SaaS Revenue & Churn Analysis](https://portfolio-mo.vercel.app/projects/saas-revenue-churn-analysis): board-meeting analysis for a fictional B2B SaaS company (practice dataset, 600 customers). Found that Starter-plan customers churn at 71% versus a 52% average, that annual billing lowers churn within every plan except Enterprise, and that no customer using 60%+ of features churned. Flagged 85 low-usage active customers (about $82K in monthly revenue) for retention outreach, and showed that revenue growth slowed sharply in 2025. Python (pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn), Tableau. [Code and notebooks](https://github.com/Mahabala-O/saas-revenue-churn-analysis)
- [U.S. Electric Vehicle Market Share](https://portfolio-mo.vercel.app/projects/us-ev-market-share): state-level analysis of 2023 light-duty vehicle registrations from the U.S. Department of Energy's Alternative Fuels Data Center. California has 13% of U.S. vehicles but 35% of its EVs; outside California the EV share is 0.92%. Ranked states by how many EVs they are short of the national average and recommended Texas, Ohio, and Pennsylvania for charging investment. Python (pandas), Tableau. [Code and notebooks](https://github.com/Mahabala-O/Analyzing-U.S.-Electric-Vehicle-Market-Share)

## How I work

- I lead with the business question, then the finding, then what someone should do about it.
- I say what the data can't support. Both case studies end with their limitations, and the churn study notes that its risk score was tested on the same customers it describes.
- My Human-Computer Interaction background means I think about who reads a dashboard and what decision it is for.
